title: Dukascopy lane export-side fix (no T1 run in this ticket): (1) QM_DWX_M1_Overlap_Export.mq5 CopyChunk must not accept copied=0 as final - retry a zero-tick chunk with bounded backoff and record per-chunk tick counts and the expected-minute bar per chunk; (2) ExportOne/receipt: a symbol is COMPLETE only when exported minutes >= expected minutes from the fixed-window bar minus the documented session-closure allowance, else SHORT_READ with ratio and the list of short chunks (never PASS on written_rows>0); (3) wrapper dwx_m1_overlap_export.py surfaces the per-chunk journal into export_receipt.json and fails the receipt loud on any SHORT_READ; (4) reconcile_overlap.py: gap-based check (longest silent interval between consecutive DWX minutes within a trading week) so the AUDCAD class (25-day hole at 84% aggregate coverage) is labeled SHORT_READ_GAP, not ordinary FAIL; compile the script with MetaEditor on a NON-factory path (framework compile path, not T1-T10/T_Live) and bind the .ex5 sha; the governed T1 export rerun is a separate work item the orchestrator enqueues after review
why_now: ca955879 (APPROVED 2026-09-15 05:3xZ) proved the 2026-09-13 export receipt was PASS 37/37 while 10 symbols carried 61-2,607 of ~180,000 minutes and AUDCAD lost 25 days: CopyChunk treats copied=0 as a valid final result with no retry and no completeness bar, and the receipt's only success criterion was written_rows>0. Every future Dukascopy overlap/splice decision reads these receipts, so the export must be fixed before any T1 probe slot is spent again. Not book-sprint critical; paced behind sprint tickets.
acceptance: mq5: CopyChunk retries a copied=0 chunk at least 3 times with backoff (e.g. 2 s / 5 s / 10 s) and journals per chunk: symbol, chunk window, attempt, copied ticks, GetLastError; a chunk that stays at 0 after retries is recorded as ZERO_TICK_CHUNK, not silently accepted

mq5 + wrapper: expected minutes per symbol computed from the fixed-window bar (the P1 manifest minute counts or the Dukascopy-side count; state which) minus a documented session-closure allowance per instrument class (FX 24x5, indices/commodities session hours); receipt status COMPLETE / SHORT_READ with exported/expected ratio and the short chunks listed; SHORT_READ never becomes COMPLETE by any downstream aggregation
wrapper: export_receipt.json carries the per-chunk journal and an overall status that is FAIL when any symbol is SHORT_READ; unit tests for the receipt classification with synthetic chunk journals

reconcile_overlap.py: gap-based check (longest silent interval inside a trading week, threshold documented, e.g. > 24 h on a weekday) yields SHORT_READ_GAP; unit test with the AUDCAD pattern (dense - 25-day hole - dense) asserting SHORT_READ_GAP; existing 34 tests stay green
